name: moodle-edtech-qa-automation-platform
description: Cucumber-first Playwright TypeScript automation skeleton for controlled Moodle teacher workflows.

scripts.test:local:smoke: ts-node scripts/run-cucumber-with-scenario-guard.ts --name test-local-smoke --profile smoke --tags "@phase4 and @local and not @wip"
scripts.test:local:teacher-workflow: ts-node scripts/run-cucumber-with-scenario-guard.ts --name test-local-teacher-workflow --profile e2e --tags "@phase5 and @local and not @wip"
scripts.test:local:grading: ts-node scripts/check-grading-data.ts && ts-node scripts/run-cucumber-with-scenario-guard.ts --profile e2e --tags "@phase6 and @local and not @wip" --name test-local-grading
scripts.test:demo:smoke: ts-node scripts/run-cucumber-profile.ts demo --profile smoke --tags "@phase4 and @local and not @wip"
scripts.test:demo:teacher-workflow: npm run moodle:seed:ready && ts-node scripts/run-cucumber-profile.ts demo --profile e2e --tags "@phase5 and @local and not @wip"
scripts.test:demo:grading: npm run moodle:seed:ready && ts-node scripts/run-cucumber-profile.ts demo --guard-label test-demo-grading --profile e2e --tags "@phase6 and @local and not @wip"
scripts.test:demo:all: npm run moodle:seed:ready && ts-node scripts/run-cucumber-profile.ts demo --guard-label test-demo-all --profile demo
scripts.test:demo:screencast:all:run: npm run moodle:seed:ready && ts-node scripts/run-cucumber-profile.ts demo --screencast --headed --guard-label test-demo-screencast-all --profile demo
scripts.test:demo:screencast:smoke: ts-node scripts/run-cucumber-profile.ts demo --screencast --headed --profile smoke --tags "@phase4 and @local and not @wip"
scripts.test:demo:screencast:teacher-workflow: npm run moodle:seed:ready && ts-node scripts/run-cucumber-profile.ts demo --screencast --headed --profile e2e --tags "@phase5 and @local and not @wip"
scripts.test:demo:screencast:grading:run: npm run moodle:seed:ready && ts-node scripts/run-cucumber-profile.ts demo --screencast --headed --guard-label test-demo-screencast-grading --profile e2e --tags "@phase6 and @local and not @wip"
scripts.test:fast:smoke: ts-node scripts/run-cucumber-profile.ts fast --profile smoke --tags "@phase4 and @local and not @wip"
scripts.test:fast:teacher-workflow: npm run moodle:seed:ready && ts-node scripts/run-cucumber-profile.ts fast --profile e2e --tags "@phase5 and @local and not @wip"
scripts.test:fast:grading: npm run moodle:seed:ready && ts-node scripts/run-cucumber-profile.ts fast --guard-label test-fast-grading --profile e2e --tags "@phase6 and @local and not @wip"
scripts.clean:local: npm run clean:reports && npm run clean:artifacts
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.moodle:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.moodle:seed:ready: npm run moodle:seed && npm run moodle:seed:env && npm run moodle:seed:auth && npm run check:data && npm run check:grading-data
